name: Crankshaft position sensor - stall and no start
description: Without the crankshaft signal the ECM does not know where the pistons are, so it stops injecting: the running engine stalls and will not restart. The engine itself is fine - a classic case where the symptom points at the wrong part.

steps.note: Waiting for the cluster bulb check to finish
The crankshaft sensor connector falls off
1. No pulses, no injection: the engine stalls
2. P0335: the engine was running and the speed signal vanished
The charge lamp lights too - the alternator stopped with the engine
3. Try to restart: the starter cranks, but the ECM sees no crank signal and never fires
The ECM reports 0 rpm - the real engine was cranking at about 250 rpm
4. Live data confirms it: engine speed 0 while cranking means check the CKP sensor first
Repair: plug the sensor back in
The engine starts at the first attempt
